verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting platform that offers serverless functions, so billing for active compute rather than idle wall-clock time is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes how compute is metered or billed. The community billing complaints concern DDoS bandwidth overages and per-user charges, not active-versus-idle compute metering, so they do not bear on this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can pay only for active compute time rather than idle wall-clock time
